features: 4k Ultra Hd Video & 140° Wide-Angle Lens - Records stunning 4K Ultra HD video with high-fidelity audio, capturing every detail in brilliant clarity. The 140° wide-angle glass lens provides an expansive field of view with excellent light transmission, significantly reducing image distortion. Perfect for travel vlogging, outdoor adventures, landscape photography, and group shots in tight spaces. Solves the common problem of limited viewing angles and poor image quality found in basic portable cameras.

128gb Built-In Storage & 90-Minute Battery - Features 128GB internal memory, storing up to 24 hours of H.264 footage, and an 800mAh battery delivering 90 minutes of continuous recording. Includes a card reader for fast data transfers to phones and computers. Ideal for full-day recording sessions, long trips, and outdoor activities, eliminating frustrations from insufficient storage and frequent recharging.

Loop Recording & Full Waterproof Protection - The camera’s loop recording function automatically overwrites the oldest footage when the memory card is full, ensuring uninterrupted recording. It is equipped with a fully waterproof casing, providing reliable underwater performance up to 66 feet (20 meters), making it perfect for aquatic adventures, while still offering protection in all weather conditions.

360° Swivel Clip & Magnetic Mounting - swivel detachable clip and magnetic lanyard enable secure attachment to clothing, helmets, bike handlebars, and metal surfaces. Paired with a multi-purpose mount, it supports hands-free operation for cycling, hiking, and action sports, ensuring stable, footage and solving unstable mounting problems.

Wireless Preview & 32-Foot Wi-Fi Range - Quick Wi-Fi connection to smartphones enables live previews, instant playback, and seamless file transfers. With a 32-foot wireless range, you can remotely access and share content, perfect for social media creation, fieldwork documentation, and family moments—eliminating cable hassle and slow transfers.
description: Our ultra-portable action body camera is your reliable all-in-one companion for travel, outdoor adventures and daily recording, solving all common pain points of basic portable cameras. It captures stunning 4K Ultra HD video with high-fidelity audio, paired with a 140° wide-angle glass lens that reduces distortion and boosts light transmission. Ideal for vlogging, landscape shooting and tight-space group shots, it eliminates the trouble of narrow viewing angles and blurry footage. Equipped with 128GB built-in memory that stores up to 24 hours of H.264 footage, plus a 90-minute continuous recording battery and fast card reader, it supports full-day trips and outdoor activities, getting rid of the hassle of insufficient storage and frequent recharging. It features auto loop recording for non-stop use without manual file deletion, and a 66ft/20m fully waterproof casing that works reliably for swimming, snorkeling, rainy or snowy days, solving storage limit and water damage risks. The detachable 360° swivel clip and strong magnetic mount allow secure attachment to clothes, helmets or bikes, enabling true hands-free operation for cycling, hiking and action sports, no more unstable mount
